messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and for a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a quick wash (soft cloth, mild soap). Use a tuner to bring it to standard pitch. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and shows you care. | | **2. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Capture the body, neck, headstock, strings, and any imperfections. Use natural light and a neutral background. | Good photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of disputes over condition. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check sites like Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local classifieds. Look at similar models, age, and condition. | Knowing the going rate helps you price competitively. | | **4. Write a Clear Listing** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, condition notes, and any accessories (case, strap, picks). Mention if it’s been tuned recently. | Transparency builds trust and speeds up negotiations. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform** | • **Reverb** – great for musical gear, buyer protection.
• **eBay** – wide audience, auction or fixed price.
• **Craigslist/Facebook Marketplace** – local sales, no shipping hassles.
• **Local Music Stores** – consignment or direct sale. | Pick the one that best matches your urgency, price expectations, and willingness to ship. | | **6. Set a Realistic Price** | Start slightly above your target to allow room for negotiation. | Buyers often expect to haggle; a higher starting point keeps you from underselling. | | **7. Decide on Shipping vs. Local Pickup** | • **Local pickup** – no shipping costs, instant payment.
• **Shipping** – use a sturdy case, bubble wrap, and insured postage. | Shipping expands your buyer pool but adds cost and risk. | | **8. Handle Negotiations Professionally** | Respond promptly, keep tone friendly, and be prepared to justify your price with photos and market data. | Good communication reduces back‑and‑forth and can lead to a quicker sale. | | **9. Finalize the Sale** | • For local: meet in a safe public place, accept cash or a verified digital payment.
• For shipping: use a trackable service, get a receipt, and consider insurance. | Protects both parties and ensures you receive payment. | | **10. Offer a Return Policy (Optional)** | A short return window (e.g., 48 hrs) can reassure buyers. | Builds confidence but be clear on conditions (e.g., return shipping costs). | ### Quick Tips - **Highlight Unique Features** – If your guitar has custom finishes, a special pickup, or a unique history, mention it. - **Mention Any Repairs** – If you’ve had a new bridge or nut installed, note it. - **Use Keywords** – “Acoustic guitar,” “steel‑string,” “mid‑range,” “good condition” help search algorithms. - **Safety First** – When meeting in person, choose a well‑lit, populated area and let someone know where you’re going. ### Example Listing > **Title:** 2015 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition > **Description:** > • Brand: Yamaha > • Model: FG800 > • Year: 2015 > • Condition: Light wear on the fretboard, no cracks. > • Accessories: Original case, strap, picks. > • Tuned to Standard (E‑A‑D‑G‑B‑E). > • Price: $350 (negotiable). > • Local pickup in [City] or insured shipping available. Feel free to adjust the price based on your research. Good luck with your sale!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We can provide steps: research market value, clean instrument, take photos, list on platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips. Also mention local music stores, consignment, trade-in. Provide tips for negotiation. Also mention warranties, return policy. Possibly mention using the tune_instrument function? But that seems unrelated. The user didn't ask about tuning. So we don't need to call the function. Just give advice.
